title: Flock transparency-portal Prohibited Uses snapshot + 5 audit-log Reason fields
summary: Two-item request. Item 1 asks for a screenshot, printout, or export of the "Prohibited Uses" section of the Department's Flock Safety transparency portal as it currently appears. Item 2 asks for the audit log entry — including the Reason field — for five specific ALPR searches identified by record ID and date (four on 3/4–3/5/2026, one on 2/26/2026).
filed_because: Snapshots the Department's public-facing Prohibited Uses language at a point in time (useful against later silent edits) and pulls the underlying Reason-field content for a small, specific set of searches for cross-checking.
notes: Filed 2026-09-14. Statutory 10-day initial determination due 2026-09-24 (Gov. Code § 7922.535(a)).
